name: Tochuu Gesha
source:
You puppet hunky characters and go thorough the nasty stories by selecting the scenario.

The fates of the heroes depend on your choices!!

[Edited from [url=http://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/list.cgi?id=G000518100103]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
translation:
你將操縱英俊的角色，透過選擇情節走過一個個糟糕的故事。

英雄們的命運取決於你的選擇！

［改寫自[url=http://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/list.cgi?id=G000518100103]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]］
